strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: ej lale keybox eo kiõ nae Google's revocation list (CRL) im kajeoñ elōn source ko mae ien eo ej lo juon keybox eo ejimwe, ippāñ juon backup eo ej make kōmmane im bar jinoe Google jerbal ko. Ej jerbal ilo aolep tap im ej aikuj internet (1-3 minute).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox jen network: ej bōk juon keybox jen official repository eo (GitHub) im kejbãrok e ñan /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Ej aikuj internet im ej bōk 1-3 minute. Kar kōjerbale ñe smart fetch eo ej likjab ak ke keybox eo kar ukōte ilo pein.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: lale Remote Key Provisioning modules ko rej bed, lale TEE attestation certificate version eo, im kwalok KmInstallKeybox tool state eo. Ejjab ukōt jabdrewot — juon pija in jekjek in device eo.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): ej kwalok Widevine level indicator ko (L1/L3) jen dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, im system properties ko jet. Ejjab ukōt jabdrewot.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP kōkmman: ej jerbal sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Ej kōmman bwe en emmanlok attestation ko ñe automatic pass eo ejjab jerbal. Kajjojo ettōr ej kwalok juon lain in tōprak/jab emman.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: ej jerbal sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Ej kōmmane case ko rebin im ej bōk ien. Juon tokjen ealikar ej walok ilo jemlokin.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: jolok Play Store im Google jerbal ko (GMS+GSF) data im bar jino device eo make. Ñan kamool ko rebin wōt — ejjab uññūr pija ko am ak file ko am.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: ej lale RKP certificate attestation state eo an device eo im bar kōjepļaaktok attestation properties ko elañe ej aikuj. Ejjab tōpar melele ko an armij.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: ej kōmman Google services framework (SOTER) abañ ko ikijen device attestation. Kar kōjerbale ñan jet device ko rej atartar ion SOTER ijellokin Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: ej kōmman sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Ej kōjerbal fingerprint eo kar kālete (local/advanced) im kōkāāl pif.prop/pif.json file ko. Juon tokjen eo ealikar ej walok ilo log eo.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: ej kwalok kin jekjek in engine eo, fingerprint file ko (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), im log ko. Lale wōt — ejjab ukōt jabdewōt.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: ej jerbal sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ej bōktok Canary Engine eo ekãl tata ñan lale bwe en jerbal ibben RKP certificate ko (Pāpode 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: ej lale TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), keybox file ko (active vs user), fingerprint in device eo emol ak spoofed, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP key ko. Diagnostic display wōt.
strings.hintKbSlots: Module in ej lale ruo jikin keybox ko: eo moktata (ekwojarjar, ejjab jako) im eo kein karuo (rejjojo). Tab in ej kwalok ta slot eo ej jerbal, ukōt joñan eo emman, ak kōketak secondary ñan primary ilo kajjitōk eo ealikar — ippāñ backup ko im juon log eobrak.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: ej lale TEE key import eo, library injection eo ilowaan keystore2, revocation status eo (CRL), protection-list coverage eo im RKP state eo. Read-only — ejjab ukōt jabdrewot.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Laajrak in kōjparok eo ej bar kōmmane jen aolep app ko kar install.
• Custom-ROM compatibility layer eo ej bar kōjerbale.
• Keybox eo ej jerbal ej bar kōjerbale.
#001#000#service ko rej ej bar jino.
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: ej kwalok kin jekjek in primary im secondary slot ko im ukōt joñan eo ikõtan ir. Primary eo (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) ej iien otemjej kōjparok im jab jako. Kōļapļo̧k secondary eo n̄an primary ej aikuj in kam̧ool eo ealikar.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Kōļapļo̧k slot eo kein karuo n̄an primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ej erom primary slot content eo.
• Primary eo kiiō ej kōjparok āinwōt juon backup m̧okta jān an bōk jikin.
• Ejelok men ej jako — jerbal eo ej maron̄ bar jepļaaktok.
000#Conue#000?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Kōmman bwe en jako jikin eo kein karuo:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml enaj jolok.
• Jikin eo moktata ejjab tōpar.

Wōnm̧aanļo̧k wōt?
